title: Clopen dimension loci in proper smooth connected families
statement: Let $S$ be Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $f:X\to S$ be proper and smooth [def-weil-proper-morphism] [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], and suppose its geometric fibres are nonempty and connected [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible], with dimension at most an integer $d\ge0$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. For $0\le i\le d$ let $S_i$ be the set of points whose geometric fibre has dimension $i$. These sets are pairwise disjoint open and closed subsets covering $S$. With their open subscheme structures, the base changes $f_i:X\times_S S_i\to S_i$ [def-pc-base-change] are proper and smooth with nonempty geometrically connected fibres of pure dimension $i$. The morphism $f_0$ is quasi-finite [pqf-def-quasifinite].
